steps.content: //Black Screen
Help... help me...
Help me...
//BG: Ancient Chinese-style interior

All night, the blizzard rages without reprieve. Fierce winds slam heavy snow against the window frames, and beyond the house, the world lies buried in a vast white desolation. Even the tender spring greenery, barely beginning to sprout, now smothers beneath the drifts.
The hearth fire crackles, yet it fails to chase off the lingering chill. Wrapped in her cloak, Jichuan stares out the window, her brow deeply furrowed.
Help me...

The fragmented cries for help echo over and over in her ears. Though as faint as a flickering candle, the voice pierces the howling storm with perfect clarity, gripping her heart. She reaches for her coat.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Mother
steps.content: Chuan'er, where are you off to?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I heard someone calling for help. They may be in danger. I should go and see.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: There's no one for miles around the house. You must have misheard. It's likely just the wind.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: It wasn't the wind. I heard it clearly. It was a human voice, very faint.

steps.speaker: Mudling
steps.content: ...Chuan, come on, at least wait till the storm lets up a little. This weather's just too weird. Something about it feels... off.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Precisely because the weather is so unnatural... I have a feeling something terrible is about to happen.
Jichuan's determination is plain for everyone to see, and they all realize there's no point in trying to stop her.

steps.speaker: Jichuan's Father
steps.content: Then dress warmly. I'll have some ginger soup ready for when you return.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: ...Alright!
She pushes open the door. A frigid gust carrying swirling snow rushes in, forcing a shiver from her.
She takes a few steps forward, then cannot help glancing back.
Her father, mother, and Mudling stand by the window, watching her with concern. The house glows warm with candlelight, and she knows they have lit them for her.
...Help... Please, someone...
From afar, the cry for help sounds again. Jichuan turns her gaze forward, walking without hesitation toward the source of the voice.
//Black Screen
No longer hindered by her illness, Jichuan moves swiftly through the wind and snow, her movements nimble and sure.
The wind and snow obscure her vision, but fortunately the cries for help never cease, growing clearer with each step.
Whoosh—
Another slicing gust screams through the air, and Jichuan nearly collapses.
Half her legs vanish into the snow. The cold, piercing to the bone, drills into her marrow while icy water seeps down her collar, shaking her teeth into a frantic chattering.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: The branches along the path have all sprouted buds... It's already late spring, yet this cold snap feels deeply unnatural...
Just as Jichuan begins to ponder further, cries for help pull her from her thoughts.
Help... Someone help us...

The voice is right beside her now. Jichuan's head snaps up, and only then does she realize she has reached the village at the mountain's foot. Before her stands a crude wood shed, its roof sagging dangerously under the weight of accumulated snow.
Cries for help pour continuously from within. Jichuan hurries forward.
As she draws closer, she sees that the shed's doors and windows are completely sealed by waist-deep snow.
Miss Jiang! Help! Please, the snow's gonna bury us alive!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: You know me? Stay calm. I'll have you out in a moment!
Jichuan reaches out to clear the snow blocking the door. It should only take a moment...
Crack!
The wooden planks of the shed's roof groan, straining under the unbearable weight. From inside comes the woman's scream.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: You'll be all right. There's still room. Grab this!
Jichuan slips her plum branch through the wooden boards and yanks the trapped woman into the clearing.
No sooner have they escaped than the shed crashes down with a thunderous roar. Frightened cries fill the air.
Only now does Jichuan see that the woman is holding a baby. The infant's face is pale, its breath shallow, numbed by the long cold.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Don't be afraid. I'll get you both somewhere safe. Are your legs hurt? Can you walk?

steps.speaker: Disaster Victim
steps.content: I can... I can still walk...

steps.speaker: Disaster Victim
steps.content: Miss Jiang, there are a few more families up ahead, all old folks, real frail. They were crying for help just a bit ago, but now... now they've all gone quiet...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll get them out.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I passed an inn on my way here. It's still in good shape. Should hold through the storm. Take the child there and wait it out.
After settling the woman, Jichuan turns and moves deeper into the village.

But the deeper she goes, the more desperate the cries for help grow. Not only people trapped in houses, there are also those pinned under collapsed beams, clinging to their last breath, and others clutching the bodies of their loved ones in numb grief, refusing to let go.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Everyone, stay calm! If your home is still sound, shelter inside. If it's damaged or unstable, make your way to the inn north of town. Watch your step in the snow and keep yourselves safe!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: We're running low on supplies to keep warm. If any household is short on necessities, let me know. I'll do everything I can to secure more.

Jichuan moves tirelessly through the tottering wooden houses. Even a healthy body would break down from such relentless effort, yet she never pauses, pulling one trapped family after another from beneath the heavy snow.
But one person's strength is nothing more than a drop in the ocean against a disaster of this scale.
As she rushes from place to place, a desperate cry reaches her ears from nearby—

steps.speaker: Female Disaster Victim A
steps.content: My baby... my baby! She's not breathing...

It's the woman Jichuan rescued first. Without Jichuan's martial skill, the woman struggles through the deep snow with her child, only now making it to the inn's entrance—still exposed, not yet safe inside.
Something inside Jichuan finally snaps. She stumbles toward the woman on unsteady feet. Yet hope remains: she can see the child still clings to life.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: She's all right. She'll be all right. Here... give her to me.
Jichuan reaches for the child to treat her, but the woman clutches her daughter tight, unwilling to let go.

steps.speaker: Female Disaster Victim A
steps.content: No, no... She's cold. She's so cold...
The woman's terrified expression pierces Jichuan's heart. She does not press further. Instead, she places her palm on the child's chest and slowly channels her life force into the tiny body.
Finally, redness returns to the child's skin. A faint cry rises from the bundle in the woman's arms.
Clutching her child, the woman weeps with joy. She drops to her knees before Jichuan, bowing again and again in gratitude. Jichuan reaches down to lift her up, but her movement suddenly freezes.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Cough! Cough, cough, cough!
A mouthful of dark, congealed blood spatters across the white snow. Then familiar agony tears through her organs, seizing her insides in a vicious grip.
The villagers freeze at the horrifying sight, too shocked to move.

But no one is more terrified than Jichuan herself. She knows this pain all too well. The "contamination" that has shadowed her for years now gnaws again at her life force from within, devouring her bones, her blood, and her warmth.
She stares at her hands, the ones that just channeled her energy. Those same hands, which restored life to an infant, now rapidly lose their last trace of warmth.
Seeing her about to collapse, a small child among the villagers darts forward and catches her.

steps.speaker: Child
steps.content: Miss, you're so cold... Are you sick too?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: This... this isn't an illness. It's a countdown I cannot escape, no matter where I run.
The child fails to grasp what she means. Jichuan forces a smile, wipes the blood from the corner of her mouth, and pats the child on the head.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I'm fine. It's cold out here. Go find somewhere warm to shelter. Where are your parents?
The child points into the distance, where countless makeshift stretchers lie shrouded in white linen.
Jichuan gathers the child into her arms, sharing what little warmth lingers in her body.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Perhaps... this strange world has been unfair to us all.
Is this truly the afterlife? Then why must she live through this helplessness all over again?
The child senses Jichuan's distress, presses closer, and clings to her in an anxious search for comfort.

steps.speaker: Child
steps.content: Miss... will the snow ever stop?
Jichuan gives no answer. Instead, she simply takes the child's hand.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Come. I'll find you somewhere warm to stay.
The snow always stops eventually. But this crumbling town, these people, her body... they may not last until the skies clear.
//Black Screen
//BG: Mountain path
You've been trudging across the slippery mountain path for what feels like ages. Your legs have gone from aching soreness to a numb, dull throb.
An Eastian child, just past ten years old, is leading the way ahead. She knows these mountain paths intimately, and despite her youth, her steps stay sure and steady.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: Young hero, we're almost there... You holding up okay?

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: You know, I never would've guessed someone who looks as delicate as you could round up so many big shots to help find Shuang'er.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: Are you, like... some kind of legendary sect leader or something...?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just happen to know quite a few people, that's all.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: Oh... Wait! Your foot's bleeding!
You freeze for a moment and look down. The black boots are so sodden with snow that no bloodstains are visible, yet the footprints trailing behind you stain the snow a vivid red.
Your feet have been frozen numb for so long that you fail to notice when the soles rip open.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: That looks bad! Wait here, I'll go down the mountain and get help...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's nothing, just a scratch. Finding Jichuan is what matters.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you say we're almost there? Come on, let's go. We've come this far.
Bao hesitates, then pushes forward, though you catch her easing off her pace ever so slightly.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: It's just up ahead. The cave's super hidden. I only found it 'cause I tripped while digging for wild veggies. And when I peeked inside, I was like, whoa! Isn't that Shuang'er from town, the one who's always telling those epic stories!

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: Oh right, I'm supposed to call her Jichuan. I only learned later that Shuang'er is actually the crazy amazing manor master!

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: When I first found her, she'd mumble sometimes, calling for her mom and dad... Then she kept saying it's so cold, save them... I didn't really get it, so I just stayed with her.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: We're here!
Bao suddenly stops and lifts a hand, brushing dead wood and weeds aside. There, concealed in the mountain wall and blurred by wind and snow, lies a narrow cave entrance.
You duck inside. The cave feels slightly warmer than the outside world, yet the air holds a damp, musty smell laced with a faint trace of medicinal herbs.
Bao, who has been leading the way, steps aside. At once, your gaze lands on a slender figure sprawled on a pile of dry grass nearby.

She lies covered in a small, worn padded coat, the one Bao must have left for her. Beneath it, her white dress is soiled. One hand rests on the coat, withered and rough, the fingertips touched with an unnatural, ashen pallor.

You crouch slowly beside her. By the faint daylight seeping through the cave entrance, you lean closer to that pale face. Your fingers gently push aside the tangled strands of hair, and there it is—the red mole between her eyebrows, the one you know so well.

You have pictured this meeting with Jichuan a thousand ways. Perhaps she has already found a cure and still dresses as that Beggar Clan girl, ready to tease you. Perhaps she is full of life again, hiding behind a curtain, pretending to be a reclusive martial arts master.
But instead, you find her broken in a way you have never witnessed before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's her.

A whirl of emotions floods through you, yet all you can manage are these few words as you gently tuck the old coat around her. She lies so still, so deathly quiet, that you are afraid to check if she is even breathing.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: ...The snow... have to save them...
Jichuan's voice is barely a whisper. But even that is enough to answer the question weighing on your mind for so long—she is truly alive.
You reach out and take her wrist, so emaciated it feels like nothing but skin and bone, and through your shackles, you attempt to forge a connection.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: How's she? Is she gonna be okay?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not good. She's hanging on by a thread, fighting the Mania corruption inside her with nothing but will. But I can feel that will slipping. I need to steady her mind first.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: Oh... Th-then... is there anything I can do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need you to head outside to an open spot and keep watch. I've already called for a medical rescue team. You'll have to guide them here.

steps.speaker: Bao
steps.content: You got it! What about you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Her consciousness is trapped. She doesn't even know how bad it is. I have to go in and find her. Wake her up.
//Black Screen
The shackles' connection pulls you into Jichuan's mental domain. Before you can even steady yourself, a violent snowstorm engulfs you.
Wherever you look, blinding white fills your vision and blots out the sky.
Adrift in this vast expanse, you have no idea which way to go.
